decision_audit.decision: Use serious same-RT-hardware V2.14 vs Phoenix V3 paired evidence as a release blocker or release enabler.
decision_audit.different_path_now: Keep V3 redo_required unless this serious paired packet proves broad material V3 superiority.
decision_audit.foolish_actions: It would be foolish to hide failed rows, count wrapper elapsed as hot-path speed, or treat runability repair as broad performance superiority.
decision_audit.other_path: Only rerun row-scoped V3 OptiX-vs-Embree candidates. That would not answer whether V3 is better than V2.x.
decision_audit.was_i_foolish: No for this decision; it directly tests the user's major-performance requirement.
